definition: a narrow boat you move with a paddle
description: A man paddles a narrow yellow boat across grey water at eye level with the surface, passing a smooth rock islet with red wooden houses on it. The clip then follows him walking down a narrow cobbled old-town street between orange and yellow buildings, one hand brushing the wall. Finally he sits at an outdoor wooden table and bites into a large cinnamon bun dusted with icing sugar, a glass of latte in front of him.
